 # Funk Bot
 
-Funk Bot is a local-first personal assistant workspace. This repository is a **partial implementation**, not the full persistent-agent platform: it provides password-protected, persistent Bot identities and conversations, configurable OpenAI-compatible gateways, model-profile fallback, and reported token usage. It provides three limited audited tools, single-Bot missions and chief-led group missions, but not a computer, autonomous routines, or semantic memory. Do not use it for unattended work or assume it has the safety controls of a complete agent runtime. Optional computer-use access to your local machine is not built.
+Funk Bot is a local-first personal assistant workspace. This repository is a **partial implementation**, not the full persistent-agent platform: it provides password-protected, persistent Bot identities and conversations, configurable OpenAI-compatible gateways, model-profile fallback, and reported token usage. It provides three limited audited tools, single-Bot missions and chief-led group missions, and scheduled single-Bot routines, but not a computer or semantic memory. Do not use it for unattended work or assume it has the safety controls of a complete agent runtime. Optional computer-use access to your local machine is not built.

 ### Follow-ups
 
+### Scheduled routines
+
+The Routines screen stores up to 50 single-Bot mission templates. A five-field cron expression (numeric values, lists, ranges, `*`, and `/` steps) uses an IANA timezone. For day-of-month and weekday, if both are restricted either may match. A nonexistent spring-forward wall minute is skipped; a repeated fall-back wall minute runs once at its first occurrence. The displayed next time uses your browser's local timezone. A completed single-Bot mission can seed an editable routine; this copies the original instructions, not learned or versioned workflow steps.
+
+The single-worker scheduler checks every five seconds. Each scheduled occurrence is atomically recorded with a unique slot and a queued mission. An owner must approve its Inbox card before it can send instructions to a model and incur provider charges; normal budgets and separate tool approvals still apply. Manual Run now also requires this approval. Missed slots are caught up incrementally after downtime or a routine/global pause, with at most 20 routine missions awaiting approval, active or queued at a time (owner-created manual runs are not capped). A pending approval can occupy a slot until reviewed. Denial cancels that mission; it does not retry the occurrence. A routine pause does not stop work already created; global pause cancels queued work and stops active work, and those already-created slots are not replayed. Run now is available even when the routine itself is paused, but not during global pause. Editing a routine resets its next occurrence from the edit time, and deleting it removes its routine history while retaining its missions. A removed assigned Bot pauses its routine at the next due check; select another Bot to resume it. In-progress model streams interrupted by restart are marked failed and are not retried, because their external outcome or provider charges may be unknown. Recovery covers recorded, not-yet-started routine missions, not exactly-once external actions. This scheduler is designed for one backend worker only; real Docker volume upgrade and long-running recovery are unverified here.
+
 ### Owner-initiated handoffs
 
 In a Bot spotlight, open Handoffs to choose another Bot and enter a reason and context. This immediately creates and starts a receiver mission, subject to the existing budget, pause and tool-approval controls. Both Bot spotlights show the handoff and its mission status; Office and activity show the actual recorded event. Context is untrusted data, not permission for actions. The owner initiates these handoffs; Bots cannot autonomously hand off from arbitrary chats, and these cards are not part of multiple independent chat threads. The latest 100 handoffs per Bot are shown. Deleting a Bot can leave an anonymized handoff on the other Bot; deleting the mission removes its handoff.

+def default_chat(c,bot_id):
+    chat_id='legacy-'+bot_id
+    if not c.execute('SELECT 1 FROM bots WHERE id=?',(bot_id,)).fetchone(): raise HTTPException(404,'Bot not found.')
+    c.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO chats VALUES (?,?,?, ?,?)",(chat_id,bot_id,'Conversation',time.time(),time.time()))
+    # Adopt any legacy unlinked rows, including data created by older integrations.
+    c.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO chat_messages SELECT ?,id FROM messages WHERE bot_id=? AND id NOT IN (SELECT message_id FROM chat_messages)",(chat_id,bot_id))
+    return chat_id

+@app.get('/api/bots/{bot_id}/chats')
+def list_chats(bot_id: str,request: Request,q: str = Query(default='',max_length=200)):
+    require_auth(request);keys=configured_secrets()
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');default_chat(c,bot_id)
+        rows=c.execute("""SELECT chats.* FROM chats WHERE bot_id=? AND (?='' OR instr(lower(name),lower(?))>0 OR EXISTS
+            (SELECT 1 FROM chat_messages JOIN messages ON messages.id=chat_messages.message_id
+             WHERE chat_messages.chat_id=chats.id AND instr(lower(messages.content),lower(?))>0))
+             ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id LIMIT 100""",(bot_id,q,q,q)).fetchall()
+    return [redact_event_value(dict(row),keys) for row in rows]

+def rename_chat(bot_id: str,chat_id: str,body: ChatNameIn,request: Request):
+    require_auth(request);name=redact(body.name.strip())
+    if not name: raise HTTPException(400,'Enter a chat name.')

+    return {'id':chat_id}

+class RoutineIn(BaseModel):
+    title: str = Field(min_length=1,max_length=160)
+    instructions: str = Field(min_length=1,max_length=18000)
+    bot_id: str = Field(min_length=1,max_length=128)
+    cron: str = Field(min_length=1,max_length=120)

+def validate_routine(body, now):
+    keys=configured_secrets();title=redact_text(body.title.strip(),keys);instructions=redact_text(body.instructions.strip(),keys)
+    if not title or not instructions: raise HTTPException(400,'Enter a title and instructions.')
+    try: next_at=next_occurrence(body.cron.strip(),body.timezone.strip(),now)
+    except (ValueError,OverflowError) as exc: raise HTTPException(400,str(exc)) from exc
+    return title,instructions,next_at

+def routine_mission(c, row, scheduled_at, now):
+    mission_id=str(uuid.uuid4())
+    c.execute('INSERT INTO missions VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(mission_id,row['title'],row['instructions'],None,'queued',None,None,now,now))
+    c.execute('INSERT INTO mission_assignees VALUES (?,?,?)',(mission_id,0,row['bot_id']))
+    c.execute('INSERT INTO routine_runs VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)',(str(uuid.uuid4()),row['id'],mission_id,scheduled_at,now,'pending'))
+    return mission_id

+async def routine_tick(now=None):
+    now=time.time() if now is None else now
+    with db() as c:
+        c.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
+        paused=c.execute("SELECT value FROM config WHERE key='global_pause'").fetchone()
+        if paused and paused['value']=='1': return
+        # Bound catch-up pressure. Advance each slot atomically with its mission;
+        # a uniqueness constraint and SQLite write lock prevent duplicate slots.
+        outstanding=c.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM routine_runs JOIN missions ON missions.id=routine_runs.mission_id WHERE missions.status IN ('queued','running','waiting_approval')").fetchone()[0]
+        for row in c.execute('SELECT * FROM routines WHERE paused=0 AND next_at<=? ORDER BY next_at,id LIMIT 20',(now,)).fetchall():
+            if outstanding>=20: break
+            if not row['bot_id']:
+                c.execute('UPDATE routines SET paused=1,updated_at=? WHERE id=?',(now,row['id']));continue
+            try: next_at=next_occurrence(row['cron'],row['timezone'],row['next_at'])
+            except (ValueError,OverflowError):
+                c.execute('UPDATE routines SET paused=1,updated_at=? WHERE id=?',(now,row['id']));continue
+            routine_mission(c,row,row['next_at'],now);outstanding+=1
+            c.execute('UPDATE routines SET next_at=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=?',(next_at,now,row['id']))
+        queued=[r['mission_id'] for r in c.execute("SELECT routine_runs.mission_id FROM routine_runs JOIN missions ON missions.id=routine_runs.mission_id WHERE missions.status='queued' AND routine_runs.approval='approved' ORDER BY routine_runs.created_at LIMIT 20")]
+    for mission_id in queued:
+        if mission_id not in mission_tasks: schedule_mission(mission_id)

+async def routine_scheduler():
+    while True:
+        try: await routine_tick()
+        except asyncio.CancelledError: raise
+        except Exception: logging.getLogger('uvicorn.error').exception('Routine scheduler tick failed')
+        await asyncio.sleep(5)

+"""Bounded five-field cron evaluation in local wall time.
+
+A repeated fall-back minute fires once (its first occurrence); missing spring
+minutes are skipped. Weekday uses cron's Sunday=0 (7 is also accepted).
+"""
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo, ZoneInfoNotFoundError
+
+
+def _field(raw, low, high):
+    result=set()
+    for part in raw.split(','):
+        bits=part.split('/')
+        if len(bits)>2 or not bits[0] or (len(bits)==2 and (not bits[1].isdigit() or not 1<=int(bits[1])<=high-low+1)):
+            raise ValueError('Invalid cron field.')
+        step=int(bits[1]) if len(bits)==2 else 1
+        base=bits[0]
+        if base=='*': start,end=low,high
+        elif '-' in base:
+            bounds=base.split('-')
+            if len(bounds)!=2 or not all(x.isdigit() for x in bounds): raise ValueError('Invalid cron range.')
+            start,end=map(int,bounds)
+        elif base.isdigit() and len(bits)==1: start=end=int(base)
+        else: raise ValueError('Invalid cron field.')
+        if not low<=start<=end<=high: raise ValueError('Cron value out of range.')
+        result.update(range(start,end+1,step))
+    return result
+
+
+def parse(expression, zone):
+    fields=expression.split()
+    if len(fields)!=5 or len(expression)>120: raise ValueError('Cron needs five fields: minute hour day month weekday.')
+    try: tz=ZoneInfo(zone)
+    except (ZoneInfoNotFoundError,ValueError): raise ValueError('Enter a valid IANA timezone.') from None
+    minute=_field(fields[0],0,59);hour=_field(fields[1],0,23);day=_field(fields[2],1,31);month=_field(fields[3],1,12);weekday=_field(fields[4],0,7)
+    if 7 in weekday: weekday.add(0);weekday.discard(7)
+    return tz,sorted(minute),sorted(hour),day,month,weekday,fields[2]=='*',fields[4]=='*'
+
+
+def next_occurrence(expression, zone, after):
+    tz,minutes,hours,days,months,weekdays,anyday,anyweekday=parse(expression,zone)
+    start=datetime.fromtimestamp(after,timezone.utc).astimezone(tz).date()
+    for i in range(366*8):
+        day=start+timedelta(days=i)
+        dom=day.day in days;dow=(day.weekday()+1)%7 in weekdays
+        if day.month not in months or not (dow if anyday else dom if anyweekday else dom or dow): continue
+        for hour in hours:
+            for minute in minutes:
+                local=datetime(day.year,day.month,day.day,hour,minute,tzinfo=tz,fold=0)
+                stamp=local.timestamp()
+                back=datetime.fromtimestamp(stamp,tz)
+                if (back.year,back.month,back.day,back.hour,back.minute)!=(day.year,day.month,day.day,hour,minute): continue
+                if stamp>after: return stamp
+    raise ValueError('Cron has no occurrence in the next eight years.')

+def test_active_chat_cannot_be_deleted_and_memory_is_retained():
+    import time
+    with TestClient(service.app) as c:
+        setup(c);bot=c.post('/api/bots',json={'name':'Researcher'}).json()['id']

+        with service.db() as db:
+            db.execute('INSERT INTO runs VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',('running',bot,'running',time.time(),time.time()))
+            db.execute('INSERT INTO chat_runs VALUES (?,?)',(chat,'running'))
+            db.execute("INSERT INTO bot_memories VALUES ('memory',?,'Keep this fact',0,1,1,'owner',NULL)",(bot,))
+        assert c.delete(f'/api/bots/{bot}/chats/{chat}').status_code==409
+        with service.db() as db: db.execute("UPDATE runs SET status='done' WHERE id='running'")
+        assert c.delete(f'/api/bots/{bot}/chats/{chat}').status_code==200
+        with service.db() as db: assert db.execute("SELECT content FROM bot_memories WHERE id='memory'").fetchone()['content']=='Keep this fact'
+        assert c.get(f'/api/bots/{bot}/chats').json()[0]['id']==chat

+        c.commit()

+from datetime import datetime, timezone

+def stamp(s): return datetime.fromisoformat(s).timestamp()
+
+def test_cron_timezone_dst_and_validation():
+    # Nonexistent spring-forward minute is skipped; repeated fall-back minute fires once.
+    assert next_occurrence('30 2 * * *','America/New_York',stamp('2026-03-07T08:00:00+00:00'))==stamp('2026-03-09T06:30:00+00:00')
+    first=next_occurrence('30 1 * * *','America/New_York',stamp('2026-11-01T04:00:00+00:00'))
+    assert first==stamp('2026-11-01T05:30:00+00:00')
+    assert next_occurrence('30 1 * * *','America/New_York',first)==stamp('2026-11-02T06:30:00+00:00')
+    assert next_occurrence('0 9 * * 1-5','UTC',stamp('2026-11-13T10:00:00+00:00'))==stamp('2026-11-16T09:00:00+00:00')
+    for expression,zone in [('60 * * * *','UTC'),('* * *','UTC'),('* * * * *','Not/AZone'),('0 0 31 2 *','UTC')]:
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError): next_occurrence(expression,zone,stamp('2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'))
+

+        rid=c.post('/api/routines',json=body).json()['id']
+        assert c.put(f'/api/routines/{rid}/pause',json={'paused':True}).status_code==200

+        assert c.post(f"/api/routines/{rid}/runs/{pending[0]['id']}/decision",json={'decision':'approve'}).status_code==200

+        assert c.post(f'/api/routines/{rid}/run').status_code==423

+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_catchup_unique_slots_and_restart_preserves_unsent(monkeypatch):
+    # A committed queued slot survives a restart; slots are created once only.
+    dispatched=[];monkeypatch.setattr(service,'schedule_mission',lambda mid,*args:dispatched.append(mid))
+    now=stamp('2026-11-01T05:35:00+00:00')

+        body={'title':'Hourly','instructions':'Check','bot_id':bot,'cron':'0 * * * *','timezone':'UTC'}
+        rid=c.post('/api/routines',json=body).json()['id']
+        with service.db() as db: db.execute('UPDATE routines SET next_at=? WHERE id=?',(now-3600,rid))
+        await service.routine_tick(now);service.mark_interrupted_runs();await service.routine_tick(now)
+        history=c.get(f'/api/routines/{rid}/runs').json();assert len(history)==2
+        assert len({h['scheduled_at'] for h in history})==2
+        assert all(h['status']=='queued' for h in history)
+        await service.routine_tick(now);assert len(c.get(f'/api/routines/{rid}/runs').json())==2

+def test_restart_replays_committed_queued_routine_once_and_budget_refuses(monkeypatch):

+            row=db.execute('SELECT * FROM routines WHERE id=?',(rid,)).fetchone()

+        pending=c.get('/api/routine-approvals').json()[0]
+        assert c.post(f"/api/routines/{rid}/runs/{pending['id']}/decision",json={'decision':'approve'}).status_code==200
+        failed=wait_mission(c,rejected,{'failed'})
+        assert 'budget cap' in failed['error']
+        assert len(FakeClient.responses)==0
